answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on independent re-execution of receipts before any claim. The delta lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the walnut is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The lagoon of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a long technical clauses, one short sentence to close register, it stays short.
